verdict.rationale: Publishing independent security audits is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions third-party audits, penetration-test reports, or any review of the app or its cloud backup/sync protocol. The backup docs describe the Cloud Backup and iCloud features but say nothing about audit or verification of those mechanisms.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
